correctness.rationale: Independently derived the rate conversion theta1=kappa1/kappa3, theta2=kappa1²/(kappa2 kappa3), theta3=kappa2/kappa4 and the positive equilibrium coordinates x=theta1(1-alpha)/2, y=theta2 alpha(1-alpha)/4, z=theta3(2-alpha)/alpha. Direct substitution in the mass-action equations vanishes, and any positive equilibrium forces z>theta3 and alpha in (0,1). Symbolically verified f=4alpha(K(alpha)-K), Kprime=2(g-theta3)/alpha² with g=alpha²[(1-2alpha)theta2-2theta1]/8, the unique maximum g(alpha*)=T and all endpoint inequalities. Hence the one/three/two counts are global, including K<=theta3. Exact symbolic checks verify the cusp K* expression, f_alphaalpha=-2(3alpha theta2+2theta1-theta2) on folds, f_alphaalphaalpha=-6theta2, and the unfolding determinant 32. The physical planar Jacobian on x+y+z=K has trace -kappa1-kappa2-4kappa3*x-kappa4*(y+z)<0 and determinant proportional to theta3-g(alpha), so fold/cusp zero eigenvalues are simple in the transverse direction. A sample theta=(1,4,1/1000) produced two ordered folds K≈0.55753958 and 0.56979709; this finite example is corroboration only, not proof.

Its fixed-theta total-mass phase diagram is a natural and complete exact classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice: the threshold singles out the cusp, locates both folds, and gives the number of equilibria for every positive conserved total, including degeneracies and excluded K region. This is a bounded but reusable exact semialgebraic structural fact for the same network; no general reaction-network theorem or stability classification is claimed. Its mathematical value depends on the explicit missing classification, not the computational effort alone.
